blocks.instr: What would you say? Then tap “Show the answer”.
task: **1**  (([A friend: “Do you still see your old school friends?” You last saw them at Anna's wedding in 2019.]))
**2**  (([A colleague: “You look exhausted!” You last had a proper holiday three years ago.]))
answer: **1**  (([A friend: “Do you still see your old school friends?” You last saw them at Anna's wedding in 2019.]))
((You:)) Not really. I **haven't seen them since** Anna's wedding in 2019.
((Не виделись до сих пор → haven't + V3; since + момент. Или: It's been ages since I saw them.))
**2**  (([A colleague: “You look exhausted!” You last had a proper holiday three years ago.]))
((You:)) **It's been three years since** I had a proper holiday!
((It's been + время + since + past simple. Или: I haven't had a proper holiday for three years.))
blocks.tip: Say it aloud first, then tap “Show the answer”.

blocks.instr: Dots and boxes: complete the second sentence (2–5 words; don't change the word in capitals), then tap to check. Got it right? Draw a line. Close a box? It's yours — go again!

tasks.q: The last time I saw Paul was three weeks ago.
tasks.back: I **haven't seen Paul for** three weeks.
tasks.note: Я не видел Пола три недели: haven't + V3 + for.

tasks.q: Simona last wrote to me seven months ago.
tasks.back: I **haven't heard from** Simona for seven months.
tasks.note: hear from sb — получать известия от кого-то.

tasks.q: My parents last spoke to me a month ago.
tasks.frame: I ___ my parents for a month.
tasks.back: I **haven't heard from** my parents for a month.
tasks.note: Они месяц не давали о себе знать.

tasks.q: Chris is hungry because the last time he ate anything was Thursday evening.
tasks.frame: Chris is hungry because he ___ Thursday evening.
tasks.back: Chris is hungry because he **has not eaten anything since** Thursday evening.
tasks.note: NOT не меняем: has not (не hasn't); since + момент. Тоже верно: has not eaten since.

tasks.q: The last time I saw Tom was the day he got married in 1995.
tasks.back: I haven't **seen Tom since his wedding** day in 1995.
tasks.note: the day he got married = his wedding day; since + день.

tasks.q: The last time I saw him was when I lived in London.
tasks.back: I **haven't seen him since** I lived in London.
tasks.note: since + целое предложение в past simple: since I lived…

tasks.q: He hasn't played tennis for five years.
tasks.back: He **gave up playing tennis** five years ago.
tasks.note: give up + -ing — бросить; ago → past simple. Тоже верно: gave up tennis.

tasks.q: I first met Sarah two years ago.
tasks.back: It **has been two years since** I first met Sarah.
tasks.note: It has been + время + since + past simple. Тоже верно: is two years since.

tasks.q: I haven't seen a good film for months.
tasks.back: It's **been months since I saw** a good film.
tasks.note: haven't + V3 + for X = It's been X since + past simple. Без last: since I last saw — уже 6 слов.
